player_intent: Reload timing is enforced by the match host equally for every weapon and player.
acceptance_rule: Start/cancel intent derives sender on the server; only server deadline completion transfers ammunition once; duplicate/early completion does not refill; death, weapon/round reset and disconnect discard deadlines.

nodes.role: Owns the reload policy instance and invokes it on the host physics tick.

visual_check: Existing animation still runs while the server enforces its saved duration. No animation or camera transform edits in this pass.

system_delta.reason: Extract transport-independent deadline policy and remove duplicate refill/reset overrides; leave existing locomotion and presentation owners intact.

current.system: Client completion with duplicate refill owners

candidate.system: Host clock policy with one ammo commit path
